shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv --depth=0; rg -n \"Unknown tool|ToolRegistry\" src/orchestration -g '*test.ts'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts 2>/dev/null || sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/ajv/lib/core.d.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'declare module .ajv.|interface Options|validateSchema\\(' node_modules/@types node_modules/ajv -g '*.d.ts' | head -80 && git log --oneline -5 && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show HEAD:src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '35,75p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then sed -n '1,80p' scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo no-reanchor; fi; rg -n \"Unknown tool|throws.*unregistered\" specs adrs src -g '*.md' -g '*.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"; rg -n '\"ajv\"|node_modules/ajv' package-lock.json | head -30; git status --short; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix Ajv schema validation compatibility" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
